comprehensibility.reason: Self-contained; terms are standard domain vocabulary.

feasibility.reason: Implementable with known automotive technology; contradicts nothing stated.

parent_fit.reason: Implements the averaged, percent, 1 %-resolution output of ARCH_ENG_FUEL_LEVEL.

unambiguity.reason: '10 s average' does not say moving vs. block average, and neither recipient nor report period is stated.
unambiguity.suggestion: Say 'moving average over the last 10 s', the recipient (VCU) and the report period.

variant_consistency.reason: Lives in subsystems/eng (diesel-only folder); its parent is gated the same (`not bev`) or ungated, so it never exists without its parent.

verifiability.reason: Averaging window, unit and rounding are testable.
